description: Qualor's security rules (the qualor engine): one SQL injection per language with a bound-parameter negative next to it; a .semgrepignore and a file under tests/ must change nothing

notes.negatives: silent by design: the bound-parameter query next to each finding
notes.scope: js/ and python/tests/ are listed in .semgrepignore and tests/ is one of OpenGrep's default ignores; the qualor engine names every in-scope file on the command line, so both are scanned
notes.kinds: python/tests/helpers.py is main: the default test globs for python match file names (test_*.py, *_test.py, conftest.py), not a tests/ directory
notes.severity: high and issue from the pack manifest (metadata.severity, metadata.kind of each rule)
